Title: Umbraco Automate connector for Jira
Description: Create Jira Cloud issues, add comments and move issues from Umbraco Automate, and start automations from signed Jira webhooks. Credentials stay in configuration, never in automations.

AuthorDetails.Name: Pascal Meyer
AuthorDetails.Description: Umbraco developer and community package author.

RelatedPackages.Description: Core automation system for Umbraco CMS

Screenshots.Caption: An automation that creates a Jira issue when a page is published.
The Create Jira issue step, set to retry, so a create whose response was lost is retried without a second issue.
Project, issue type, summary and description for the new issue.
A webhook trigger that only accepts deliveries signed with your Jira webhook secret.
